reviewMethod: Viewed full-video low-resolution contact sheets, then exact ffmpeg seek frames every 2 seconds for the accepted segment. Matching uses canonical equipment, grip and posture, not title similarity. This review does not publish clips.

accepted.framingNoteZh: 照教学前半段从侧后方斜拍：坐姿、反手握长杆，把双手、肘部、背部和杆的完整轨迹拍进画面。后半段切到侧面讲解；同屏对比时先对齐前半段连续示范，不必跟随镜头切换。
accepted.framingNoteEn: Match the rear three-quarter view in the first half: sit down, hold the long bar with an underhand grip, and keep both hands, elbows, back and the full bar path visible. The second half switches to side-view explanation; align your comparison with the continuous demonstration before that cut.
accepted.visualEvidence: Exact frames at 542/544/546/548/550s show a seated cable pulldown with supinated, roughly shoulder-width grip on a long bar, upper and lower positions, and controlled repetitions. At 552s the subtitles explicitly identify the underhand pulldown. 554–560s switches to a side view for upper-position/back-tension explanation. No red-cross/error demonstration appears in the reviewed 534–564s frames. Canonical 0245 GIF was separately downloaded and viewed as all 12 coalesced frames; its seated long-bar supinated pulldown matches the source equipment/grip/posture.
accepted.reviewCaveat: The short teaching excerpt includes a camera cut. It is usable for learning, but the rear-angle repetition portion is the better manual-comparison reference. Main agent must check the final encoded excerpt before upload.

rejected.reason: The instructor discusses neutral grip, but the reviewed original shows a long pulldown bar throughout, not an actual V-bar or twin parallel-grip handle demonstration. Discussion alone is not the matching exercise.
No confirmed single-arm handle, rope, straight-arm, behind-neck or lever-machine demonstration in this original. Do not map cable long-bar teaching to these different variants.

There are other overhand long-bar portions, but they are not a newly confirmed distinct variant relative to already published 0198. Keep this expansion from inflating coverage with duplicate generic pulldown mappings. A later GIF-specific equivalence review may decide these separately.

The original teaches standing bilateral dumbbell lateral raise, already covered by 0334. No confirmed loaded unilateral, supported, full-can/thumbs-up, seated, incline or cable/lever variant. Gestures used while explaining are not exercise demonstrations.
